![Stakeholder Management: The Ultimate Guide | Simply Stakeholders](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-fe09c942bb18:4)
Stakeholder management is `the strategic process of identifying, analyzing, and engaging individuals or groups who can affect or be affected by a project's outcome`.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/teams/marketing/guide/stakeholder-management)[[2]](https://www.projectmanagement.com/wikis/295467/stakeholder-management)

### The Stakeholder Management Process

- **Identify:** List all internal (team members, executives) and external (customers, suppliers, regulators) participants.
- **Analyze:** Assess each stakeholder's power, influence, and level of interest using a matrix.
- **Prioritize:** Rank who needs close management, regular updates, or minimal effort.
- **Plan:** Create a customized communication and engagement strategy for key groups.
- **Monitor:** Track sentiment, resolve conflicts promptly, and adjust engagement as the project evolves.[[1]](https://www.pmi.org/learning/library/stakeholder-management-task-project-success-7736)[[2]](https://www.atlassian.com/teams/marketing/guide/stakeholder-management)[[3]](https://projectmanagement.ie/blog/what-is-stakeholder-management/)[[4]](https://instituteprojectmanagement.com/au/blog/what-is-stakeholder-management/)[[5]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/stakeholder-management)

Learn more about the core phases and definitions in this [Stakeholder Management Guide](https://simplystakeholders.com/resources/guides/stakeholder-management/).[[1]](https://simplystakeholders.com/resources/guides/stakeholder-management/)If you'd like, let me know:
